attributes.description: How much of the capacity bill nobody is using, and what we can measure.

query.esql:
FROM billing_realized_pool_lookup
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| EVAL dep = deployment_id
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL amount = total_chargeable_units * conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| EVAL ck = composite_key::keyword
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| WHERE heap_used_pct_p95 IS NOT NULL
| EVAL util_score = (conf_utilization_memory_weight * (heap_used_pct_p95 / 100.0)
                   + conf_utilization_storage_weight * (COALESCE(disk_used_pct_p95, heap_used_pct_p95) / 100.0))
                  / (conf_utilization_memory_weight + conf_utilization_storage_weight)
| EVAL reclaimable = amount * (1 - util_score)
| STATS `Reclaimable` = SUM(reclaimable),
        d = COUNT_DISTINCT(dep), n = COUNT_DISTINCT(ts)
| EVAL Measured = CONCAT(TO_STRING(d), CASE(d == 1, " deployment, ", " deployments, "),
                         TO_STRING(n), " days")
| KEEP `Reclaimable`, Measured

query.esql:
FROM cluster_tier_and_datastream_contribution_lookup
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| WHERE tier == "hot/content"
| EVAL ts = @timestamp
| EVAL ck = composite_key::keyword
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN billing_realized_pool_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_deployment_contribution_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| WHERE heap_used_pct_p95 IS NOT NULL
| EVAL util_score = (conf_utilization_memory_weight * (heap_used_pct_p95 / 100.0)
                   + conf_utilization_storage_weight * (COALESCE(disk_used_pct_p95, heap_used_pct_p95) / 100.0))
                  / (conf_utilization_memory_weight + conf_utilization_storage_weight)
| EVAL share_storage = CASE(deployment_sum_store_size > 0,
                            tier_and_datastream_sum_store_size * 1.0 / deployment_sum_store_size,
                            0.0)
| EVAL tier_cost = share_storage * data_tier_capacity_ecu * util_score * conf_chargeable_unit_rate
| STATS cost_day = SUM(tier_cost), bytes_day = SUM(tier_and_datastream_sum_store_size) BY ts
| STATS mean_cost = AVG(cost_day), mean_bytes = AVG(bytes_day)
| EVAL `Cost per terabyte` = CASE(mean_bytes > 0,
                                  mean_cost / (mean_bytes / 1000000000000.0), null)
| KEEP `Cost per terabyte`
